lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: Well howdy, crawler. Welcome to Fort Tiner. Population six, and one goat that thinks it's the mayor.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: Rule one of Fort Tiner: no climbin' on the fort. Rule two: climb everything else. That's what you're here for.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: The summit sits at fourteen thousand one hundred and fifteen feet. I've been up there twice. Came down the fast way once.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: If a crawler don't come back down by sundown, we ring the bell. Then we eat their beans. Out of respect.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: Been seein' little metal bugs over the ridge. Corpo drones. They ain't here for the goat.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: They keep circlin' the peak. You get up there and tell me what they're lookin' at. That's the job.

lines.speaker: Dusty
lines.text: Gus come off the slope white as a sheet. Says Vaughn found a shaft the company already knew about. That's why the drones came.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: Prize counter's back in the Safe Room, sugar. Win yourself some tickets up that rock and go treat yourself.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: That helmet? Lamp works fine. Battery don't. We're workin' on it. We've been workin' on it since eighteen fifty-nine.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: My late husband went down a mineshaft lookin' for silver. Found the System instead. Now he's a floor boss. We still write.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: Every inch you climb earns you points. Get to the top with everybody and the whole crew gets a bonus. Teamwork, darlin'.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: Those drones hover like they're takin' inventory. I don't like bein' counted.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: Climb it, sugar. If the company wants the mountain, I want our eyes on the top before theirs.

lines.speaker: MaOre
lines.text: The beam over that hole has my husband's mark on it. Vaughn read it out loud and the lamp went blue. Don't go in alone.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Folks think the treasure's up top. Heh. The treasure's DOWN, partner. Deep down. The mountain's just the lid.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I dug a hole so deep last spring, somethin' down there dug back. Polite fella. Wanted to know if we was hirin'.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Hear that rumblin'? That's the dungeon, stretchin' its legs under the Rockies. One day it's gonna come up for air.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: You want my advice? Rest on them ledges. The rock don't care how tired you are. The rock never cares.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Drones again last night. Quiet ones. They don't care about the fort. They care about what's under it.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Get to the summit. If the lid's cracked, I'll know by how the wind sounds when you come down.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: While you were on the peak, a drone dropped into the pasture. Vaughn followed it. There's a mine under the goat grass, and the planks moved.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Equip your Climbin', then hold the left mouse to haul yourself up. Let go and you drop, so only let go over a ledge, hon.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Climbin' burns stamina. When your arms start singin', find a ledge and let 'em rest a spell.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: I wrote a song about the last fella who skipped the ledges. It's a short song. Real short.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Beat the clock to the summit and there's extra tickets in it for ya. Daylight's wastin', crawler!

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: I tried to write the drones a song. They didn't clap. Rude little machines.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Sheriff wants a lookout on the peak. That's you, hon. Hold on tight and go see.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: I'm writin' it into the song so it's on the record. Vaughn found the Lucky Tuesday under the pasture. The drones were just the ushers.
